supplementary_exterior_photos.alt_text: Purdue's Math Building - Home of Department of Statistics
supplementary_exterior_photos.capture_date: Unknown; website/page date does not establish image capture date.
supplementary_exterior_photos.visual_observation: Small official departmental photo of a red-brick MATH elevation with vertical window ribbons, simpler end bays, a pale/glazed lower entrance, and trees partially obscuring the base.
supplementary_exterior_photos.supports: Building identity and a department-published example of the facade's vertical window-grouping and lower entrance treatment.
supplementary_exterior_photos.does_not_support: Compass direction, facade dimensions, a full elevation schedule, current/as-built date, roof height, roof component attribution, or calibrated material color.

visual_inspection.method: Inspected the publicly accessible 2384 × 3526 original through a temporary local review copy; the copy was not retained in the project.
visual_inspection.observation: Oblique view of the tall brick tower: broad facade has repeated vertical glazed/window strips, discrete corner/end windows, and a pale lower level; a side return is also visible. Roofline shows a parapet/raised edge and thin rooftop rail-like elements. Trees obscure portions of the lower facade.
visual_inspection.supports: A higher-resolution, dated historical view of the as-built building's broad facade pattern, simple end bays, lower-level transition, and qualitative roof-edge silhouette. It helps verify the model's broad facade vocabulary against an independent image.
visual_inspection.does_not_support: Compass direction or mapping to any model cardinal elevation; current post-2009 conditions; measured dimensions, story height, exact rooftop component identity/height, or color-calibrated material values.

comparison.result: The saved model includes broad blank wall zones and repeated vertical window groups; the newly inspected photos show that both a mostly blank end wall and a window-rich principal facade can occur on the building. No reliable direction mapping ties those photo faces to a particular model cardinal view. The photos therefore refine motif-level comparison but do not justify adding/moving openings or roof parts.

roof_height_result: No new measured elevation or spatially registered roof survey found; R10 DSM-DTM discrepancy remains unassigned to a modeled component.
interior_result: No new public as-built floor plan found; R11 Archives accession remains a physical unscanned source lead.
unresolved: Direction of each photographed elevation and its correspondence to model north/east/south/west.
